fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-09-29, an online seller collected an advance of Rs. 45,000 for a product and then blocked the number of the complainant. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-09-28 at roughly 09:15. The online submission was made by Sathish Kumar (9000000268). Manoj Karuppasamy (9000000054) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Transaction details refer to the receiving account SYN-ACC-100014. No identifying details of the suspected person were available at the time of registration. The complainant mentioned digital documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim reportedly paid in advance and was blocked by the seller.
fields.Keywords: online shopping fraud, fake seller, morning, digital document, receiving account, shopping complex, witness
